segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSE study guide.
segments.zh: 朋友们好，欢迎来到你们的频道 HSE Study Guide。

segments.text: In today's video we are going to talk about the MCQ test of the work permit system.
segments.zh: 在今天的视频中，我们要讲的是作业许可制度的选择题测试。

segments.text: And you can also find out how much knowledge you have about it through this test.
segments.zh: 通过这个测试，你们也可以了解自己在这方面掌握了多少知识。

segments.text: So let's start the video.
segments.zh: 那我们开始视频吧。

segments.text: So the first question is why do we use the work permit system?
segments.zh: 第一题是：我们为什么要使用作业许可制度？

segments.text: So for this option A has been given that to control the work in the restricted area,
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是控制受限区域内的作业，

segments.text: option B is to perform the work safely so that unwanted incidents can be prevented.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是安全地开展作业，从而防止意外事件发生，

segments.text: Option C is to implement control measures effectively and option D is to select the correct answer here.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是有效落实控制措施，选项 D 是在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D all of the above.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D，以上全部。

segments.text: Then the question is what is covered in the work permit is also safety related.
segments.zh: 下一题是：作业许可中涵盖了什么，而且是与安全相关的？

segments.text: So option A is that the statutory requirement is also, as per OSHA standard, option B is that the statutory requirement is also according to regulatory bodies,
segments.zh: 选项 A 是法定要求，而且是按照 OSHA 标准；选项 B 是法定要求，而且是按照监管机构的规定；

segments.text: option C is that the minimum safety measures so that risk can be controlled and option D is that the standard list applicable for all types of work.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是最低限度的安全措施，以便控制风险；选项 D 是适用于所有类型作业的标准清单。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer here.
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C。

segments.text: Then the next question is which of the work is low risk for which the permit is not required.
segments.zh: 下一题是：哪一项作业是低风险的、不需要许可证？

segments.text: So option A is that the radiography is option B, hot work is option C, cleaning and sweeping work and option D is the hydrotesting of the pipelines.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是射线探伤，选项 B 是动火作业，选项 C 是清洁和清扫工作，选项 D 是管道水压试验。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer here.
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C。

segments.text: Then the next question is what is the main objective of the work permit system.
segments.zh: 下一题是：作业许可制度的主要目标是什么？

segments.text: So option A is given for this that to comply with the company policy, option B is given that to maintain documents and records for the audit,
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是遵守公司政策，给出的选项 B 是保存用于审核的文件和记录，

segments.text: option C is given to prevent the incident and option D is given to generate data for accident investigation.
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是预防事件，给出的选项 D 是为事故调查生成数据。

segments.text: So the correct answer is you have to select it here.
segments.zh: 正确答案你要在这里选出来。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C。

segments.text: Then the next question is what should the issuer check before issuing the hot work permit.
segments.zh: 下一题是：在签发动火作业许可证之前，签发人应该检查什么？

segments.text: So option A is given for this that the receiver should also check the authorised signature of the permit.
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是接收人也应检查许可证上的授权签名。

segments.text: So the control measures specified in the permit is option C, the competent fire watch is available and option D is all.
segments.zh: 许可证中规定的控制措施，选项 C 是有胜任的看火人在场，选项 D 是以上全部。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer here.
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D。

segments.text: Then the next question is what should the issuer discuss before the joint site visit.
segments.zh: 下一题是：在联合现场察看之前，签发人应该讨论什么？

segments.text: So the option A is given for this that what is the requirement of the OSHA for specific work, they should discuss it.
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是针对具体作业 OSHA 有什么要求，他们应该讨论这个。

segments.text: Option B is given that the lifting or other machines or equipment should check the certifications of it.
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是应检查起重设备或其他机器设备的认证。

segments.text: Option C is given that what is the scope of work, what equipment is going to be used there, or any special conditions because of which the safety can be affected.
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是作业范围是什么、那里要使用什么设备，或者任何可能影响安全的特殊条件。

segments.text: And option D is given that what is the competency of the fire watch, stand-by-by persons or workers.
segments.zh: 给出的选项 D 是看火人、监护人员或工人的能力如何。

segments.text: So what should they discuss about this.
segments.zh: 那么他们应该就此讨论什么？

segments.text: So what are the correct options for this, you have to select it.
segments.zh: 那么这道题的正确选项是什么，你要选出来。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C。

segments.text: Then the next question is what is the restricted area among these.
segments.zh: 下一题是：以下哪一个是受限区域？

segments.text: So option A is given for this, mechanical workshop, option B is the fabrication yard which is away from the operational area.
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是机修车间，选项 B 是远离生产作业区的预制场。

segments.text: Option C is the laboratory where the chemicals are handled and option D is the flammable material handling pump area.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是处理化学品的实验室，选项 D 是易燃物料输送泵区。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer here.
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D。

segments.text: Then the next question is what are the conditions in which the permit issuer can decide
segments.zh: 下一题是：在什么情况下，许可证签发人可以决定

segments.text: that the permit that is not required there is also for a specific work.
segments.zh: 某项具体作业也不需要许可证？

segments.text: So option A is given for this that when low risk work is done, option B is given that when short term work is done, option C is given that when low cost work is done and option D is given, none of it is given.
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是进行低风险作业时，给出的选项 B 是进行短期作业时，给出的选项 C 是进行低成本作业时，给出的选项 D 是以上都不是。

segments.text: So what is the correct option for this, you have to select it here.
segments.zh: 那么这道题的正确选项是什么，你要在这里选出来。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option A.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 A。

segments.text: Then the next question is what condition can be cancelled by the work permit.
segments.zh: 下一题是：在什么情况下作业许可证可以被取消？

segments.text: So option A is that if the observer is non-compliance and that also agrees with the permit condition.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是如果观察人员发现不符合许可条件的情况。

segments.text: Option B is also given in emergency, option C is given in bad weather and option D is given in all these.
segments.zh: 还给出了选项 B，紧急情况下；给出的选项 C 是恶劣天气下；给出的选项 D 是以上所有情况。

segments.text: So the correct answer is you have to select it here.
segments.zh: 正确答案你要在这里选出来。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D。

segments.text: And then the next question is who performs the joint side inspection before issuing the work permit.
segments.zh: 然后下一题是：在签发作业许可证之前，由谁进行联合现场检查？

segments.text: So option A is given for this, worker and permit issuer option B is also given, worker and permit issuer option C is given, permit issuer and receiver and option D is given, area manager along with worker and receiver.
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是工人和许可证签发人，还给出了选项 B，工人和许可证签发人，给出的选项 C 是许可证签发人和接收人，给出的选项 D 是区域经理连同工人和接收人。

segments.text: So what is the correct answer for this, you have to select it here.
segments.zh: 那么这道题的正确答案是什么，你要在这里选出来。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C, permit issuer and receiver.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C，许可证签发人和接收人。

segments.text: So friends I hope you got to know about the MCQ test of the work permit system through this video.
segments.zh: 所以朋友们，我希望你们通过这个视频了解了作业许可制度的选择题测试。

segments.text: So that's all for today, see you in the next video with a new topic, till then take care, bye bye.
segments.zh: 今天就到这里，我们下个视频带着新话题再见，在那之前请多保重，再见。
